name: Planar Goblin
body:
Note Generally more powerful than their Material Plane counterparts, this humanoid variant are more likely be encountered as NPCs but may occasionally be allowed as player characters for high-powered campaigns.

Just as on the Material Plane, goblins are popular as mercenaries on the more warlike Lower Planes, where they serve as ready fodder under various fiendish hordes.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +4 Dex, +2 Int, +2 Wis, +2 Cha, –2 Str. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Goblin. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Gnoll, Gnome, Halfling, Infernal, and Orc. This trait alters languages.
Spell-Like Ability Choose death knell, fire breath, qualm, spider climb, or tar ball. Once decided, this choice cannot be changed. You can use the selected spell once per day as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
